summary: Preserve new.target inside class constructors, including the fact that a base constructor sees the most-derived constructor used by new.

target.notes: Thread an explicit constructor identity through the generated construction path; do not replace new.target with the statically declared class.

semantics.direct_new: new.target is the directly constructed class

caveats: System.Type can be used as an internal token only if no JavaScript constructor-object behavior is expected from new.target.

tests.name: direct construction
tests.input: class A { constructor(){ console.log(new.target === A); } } new A();

tests.name: edge: base sees derived new target
tests.input: class A { constructor(){ console.log(new.target.name); } } class B extends A {} new B();
